025628b23df11470d4eb87ee981edbf250498691.review_scope: Two-shore Hall overlap identity and its conditional Section-177 source-gate implication.
025628b23df11470d4eb87ee981edbf250498691.hypotheses_and_quantifiers: Finite disjoint labelled left shores C and O and source shore A; each of C and O separately admits a shore-saturating matching into A. No joint saturation of C union O is assumed. For any such pair of matchings, their common image size is at least delta=|C|+|O|-nu_A(C disjoint-union O); among arbitrary separate saturating matchings of the restricted shores, the minimum equals delta.
025628b23df11470d4eb87ee981edbf250498691.independent_reconstruction: For any pair of saturating maps M_C,M_O, let I be the union of their source images. Choose one matched demand edge for each distinct source in I. This is a matching in the combined graph, so |I|<=nu; inclusion-exclusion gives overlap=|C|+|O|-|I|>=delta. Conversely take a maximum combined matching of size nu and restrict to each shore. Extend each partial matching to saturate its own shore. Each augmenting path ends at a previously unused source and leaves every previously occupied source occupied, so the union of final images still contains the nu sources of the original matching. The first bound forces union size exactly nu, hence overlap=delta. Hall maximum deficiency gives delta=max_U(|U|-|N(U)|)_+.
025628b23df11470d4eb87ee981edbf250498691.downstream_interface_reconstructed: For restrictions of any full-shore saturating matchings to C=C^partial and O, the same lower bound L>=delta holds. Under the inherited Section-177 V-gate path-interference bound of at most nine other paths per gate, greedy selection gives at least ceil(L/10)>=ceil(delta/10) gates. The boundary-band estimate nu<=20d+25 yields delta>=|C|+|O|-20d-25 and hence a stronger incidence-specific floor than the old nonnegative population floor when positive.

This rejects equality for inherited full matching restrictions, not the lower bound.

Direct enumeration covered 98,212 independently saturable incidence graphs across six shore/source sizes; 22,266 had positive forced overlap; source-image mask minima, combined-matching DP, and Hall-subset deficiency agreed.

4b708e27e9e26f8c163685dfe8b033b6d6369177.review_scope: Conditional quadratic lower bound on cross-component noncrossing determinant mass after physical-edge accounting.
4b708e27e9e26f8c163685dfe8b033b6d6369177.hypotheses_and_quantifiers: Finite pure simply connected strict-rhombic disk with diameter D; the Section-50.1 order removes high-defect crossings first, then low-degree vertices. H1,H2 are distinct components of the final retained graph. Select subsets A⊂H1,B⊂H2 with |A|≥αD, |B|≥βD for fixed α,β>0, and directions within ε of centers φ1,φ2 with s=|sin(φ1−φ2)|>2ε. Conclusion: V_AB≥αβ(s−2ε)D²−CδD^(2−η), hence for sufficiently large D, V_AB≥(1/2)αβ(s−2ε)D² and is a submass of global missing-crossing M.
4b708e27e9e26f8c163685dfe8b033b6d6369177.independent_reconstruction: Partition A×B into physical crossing pairs and noncrossing pairs. By the strict-rhombic pseudoline property, each train pair crosses at most once; the Section-26.4 zonotope identity assigns |det(uτ,uσ)| to either class, so total determinant equals V_AB+W_AB. If a crossing joined vertices surviving in distinct final components, it could not have been removed during vertex pruning (both endpoints survive); if it was not initially high-defect-deleted it would remain an edge and join the components. Therefore each cross-component physical crossing lies in E_hi, and its unit-rhombus determinant is ≤1, giving W_AB≤|E_hi|≤CδD^(2−η). With angle lifts, |sin| is 1-Lipschitz, so each cross-pair determinant is ≥s−2ε. Summing αβD² pairs and subtracting W proves the bound. For fixed positive coefficient, D^(2−η)=o(D²), yielding the half-coefficient asymptotic.
falsification_controls: If s=0 or s≤2ε, the coefficient is nonpositive and the lemma is deliberately vacuous.
If either subset is sublinear rather than bounded below by fixed αD or βD, no positive quadratic term follows.
Charging all pruned edges would introduce O(λD²) and break the stated estimate; the proof relies on both endpoints being final retained vertices, so only E_hi can separate them.

6295e0dc87031fe8418bff50bd9923014072df0f.hypotheses_and_quantifiers: Finite planar pairwise-distinct labels p_i with all d_ij>=1, D>1, and 0<λ<1. Define d_ii prime=0 and for i≠j, d_ij prime squared=1+λ(d_ij²−1). Every contact remains exactly one, every noncontact is strictly above one and shortens, and Dprime²=1+λ(D²−1)<D². 6295e0dc87031fe8418bff50bd9923014072df0f.independent_reconstruction: A regular unit simplex r_i in R^(n−1) gives q_i=(sqrt(λ)p_i,sqrt(1−λ)r_i); its squared distances are λd²+(1−λ)=1+λ(d²−1). For two distinct colors, rank(JZ)=1, hence rank(A)=1 and the affine fibers are parallel lines; conversely two classes on distinct parallel lines are level sets of an affine scalar functional mapping to the two color vertices.
